ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram containing labels such as Toad, Hognose Snake, Hawk, Garter Snake, Spider, Preying Mantis, Sparrow, Mouse, Grasshopper, Rabbit, Grass, etc. Toad is located in the middle position slightly to the left in the image, and Hognose Snake is located above it and slightly to the left. A vertical arrow can be seen pointing upward from near Toad toward Hognose Snake, with the arrow tip in the direction of Hognose Snake. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the predator, that is, from prey to predator. Therefore, the arrow from Toad to Hognose Snake indicates that the toad is preyed on by Hognose Snake.
